summary.text: Cynthia Butler is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Danny Nix.
Butler is a registered nurse and former nurse union leader who says she supports Medicare for All and clean energy.

paragraphs.text: Cynthia Butler attended Cape Cod Community College, according to Ballotpedia, and earned an associate degree from Southwest Florida College in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a registered nurse, single mother, grandmother, great-grandmother and former nurse union leader.
Butler's survey responses name government transparency, Medicare for All and clean energy as key campaign messages.
She said she is passionate about protecting land, water and biodiversity.
